note: activity bar -- renders: Explorer/Search/Source Control/Run/Extensions view icons and Accounts/Settings buttons; fixed operator vocabulary
top menu bar -- renders: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help; fixed operator vocabulary
editor tab toolbar -- renders: Split Editor and More Actions buttons; fixed operator controls
close button on editor tabs -- fixed operator control; the tab label carrying the user-chosen file name stays masked

status bar -- renders: Problems, Forwarded Ports, Notifications, editor mode/EOL/encoding/indentation/selection, Screen Reader Mode; fixed labels with computed values; subtracts status.host which can display a user-supplied remote host name
